# Social — provider templates

Native n8n journal, rendering and file verification for Shotstack and JSON2Video.

Keep templates inactive. Generation and publishing start disabled. No local worker, SSH or local renderer.

Shotstack uses the verified native node and a configured Sandbox credential. JSON2Video requires Header Auth `x-api-key`.

Speech uses each provider’s native scene timing. No artificial subtitle timestamps are produced.

## Additional info

- [Full Notion documentation](https://paoloronco.notion.site/41cf0ba27c3281ab945ee3521ce3faa4)
- [Version-specific README and package files](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/social-reels-shorts/V2/JSON2Video/README.md)
- [Detailed configuration and recovery](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/social-reels-shorts/V2/JSON2Video/documentation.md)

## 1. Checked job operations

The caller execution owns claims. Lost conditional updates stop before another API action. Provider errors and unknown POST outcomes retain evidence.

## 2. Authorize the next render action

Provider identity stays fixed within a job. JSON2Video checks its remaining quota first.

## 3. Provider API

Shotstack: native node, Sandbox credential. Voice generation still costs credits and requires explicit opt-in.

JSON2Video: 600 initial credits; free plan is non-commercial evaluation only. 25 fps is the actual service output.

## 4. Poll the existing receipt

Wait without submitting again.

## 5. Verify and checkpoint

Check original MP4 dimensions, duration, audio and hash. Download a real thumbnail.

## Shared return lane

Every result returns through the checked journal.

## 6. Initialize storage once

The manual setup operation creates the separate provider-template journal. It calls no rendering API.

## 7. Authorized original media

Refresh the same render, verify its approved hash and return only the requested file. No mutation API is called here.

## 8. Approved source files and inline Shotstack edit

Original files are bundled once. Shotstack HTML5 blocks network requests: encode the prepackaged WebP derivatives and original font as data URIs, deduplicated through merge fields. Enforce a 450 kB request cap. JSON2Video uses signed original URLs.

## 9. Private gallery

Preview approved media without publishing.
